description: Before you add or upgrade dependencies, especially to a release newer than your training data: give the packages and the versions you are about to install. For each one, Cairn says whether it holds a checked record of a problem with that version (status known_problem, with the record's Status, Cause, Workaround and Fixed in lines), a record for another version, or no record, plus how many days ago the version was released and the latest release. No record is not a safety claim. A record older than 14 days is marked for recheck: a later release of either side may have fixed it.

name.description: Registry name, for example typescript or pydantic.

version.description: The version you are about to install; omit for the latest.

name: cairn_check_dependencies
title: Check dependencies before installing
